source_value.interpretation: historical simulator constant only; not accepted measured resonance

sensitivity_band.rationale: ±10% around the legacy 2.4 GHz simulator constant; sensitivity only, not an operating tolerance

conclusions: At the legacy 2.4 GHz simulator value, free-space wavelength is 0.12491352416666666 m and period is 4.166666666666667e-10 s.
These quantities follow directly from exact SI constants and the legacy frequency value; they do not validate that 2.4 GHz is a physical RFS resonance.
No extraction rate, purity, efficiency, equipment safety, optimal frequency, or hardware-readiness claim is promoted.
